title: Air Sensor Failure
shortDescription: Cabinet air probe open or shorted.
fullDescription: Traulsen Intelli-A-Trol controllers post E-1 when the cabinet air probe is invalid.
whenToCallPro: Traulsen sealed-system and electrical work requires a licensed commercial tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: Cabinet air probe open or shorted.

faq.q: How do I clear the alarm?
faq.a: Press the alarm/silence button on the Intelli-A-Trol controller after addressing the underlying issue.

title: Compressor Run Time Exceeded
shortDescription: Compressor on too long without temp drop.
fullDescription: Indicates poor cooling capacity. Investigate refrigerant, fan, and coil.

fixSteps.title: Test evap fan
fixSteps.instruction: Verify fan runs continuously in normal mode.

whenToCallPro: Traulsen sealed-system and electrical work requires a licensed commercial tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.
